info.name: Services API (FULL)
info.description:
# Auth
`Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`

Get token from auth-service ({{authBaseUrl}}).

# FitForge success envelope
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": { } }
```

# FitForge paginated list
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Success", "data": { "items": [], "meta": { "page", "limit", "total", "totalPages" } } }
```

# Error envelope (all routes)
```json
{ "statusCode": 404, "error": "Not Found", "message": "...", "path": "/...", "timestamp": "..." }
```

# Legacy routes (questions, profile, etc.)
Return raw JSON without the FitForge `success` wrapper.
